scope: Public recorded-pose presentation media and aggregate condition metadata for the final QuadFDB benchmark.
count_scope: Counts use the final audited QuadFDB benchmark composition (156 conditions × 10 repetitions), not the incomplete counts in the historical presentation-media snapshot.
overview_operation: Crop existing 192-pixel left/right margins and 26-pixel top margin, retaining all 13 × 12 recorded-pose tiles; scale to 2304 × 1404 and re-encode H.264 CRF22 retaining recorded timing and BT.709 color metadata.
